Pooled over the four traces (each trace x repetition is one pair on an identical trace). Note: with n = 5 the two-sided Wilcoxon cannot go below p = 0.0625, hence the pooled test. Ratio = router / fixed HTTP/3 (geometric mean); 'slower in' = pairs where the router needed more time per round; Wilcoxon signed-rank on the log ratios.

| Router | pairs | geometric-mean ratio vs fixed HTTP/3 | slower in | Wilcoxon p (two-sided) |

| oracle | 20 | 1.051 | 10/20 | 0.18 |
| reactive | 20 | 1.248 | 19/20 | 0.00012 |
| ducb | 20 | 1.433 | 19/20 | 0.0001 |
